svg.title: Clustering the real data and three shuffled copies of it
svg.desc: Schematic of Eisen et al., PNAS 95:14863 (1998), Fig. 3. Five red and green heat maps side by side: the data in its original order, the data after clustering, and three randomized copies of the data, each clustered the same way. Large blocks of red and of green appear only in the clustered real data. The colors are the paper's, averaged over blocks of genes.
